svg.title: Metal runtime comparison
svg.desc: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next · M5 Max · 40-core GPU · 128 GB. 4,096 input · 128 output tokens · batch 1 · greedy. ¹ MFQ: published prefill value; others: MTP off. oMLX includes first-token overhead.. Shaded rows: similar weight size. Draft setups differ; oMLX uses adaptive MTP. See notes.. https://github.com/Tylogi/MFQ
